title: RNA Extraction from Filtered Vent/Crustal Fluids or Seawater
author: Julie Huber
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iuxcexn
materials: Thaw 50 ml tubes with filter on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Workspace
steps.instruction: Decontaminate the bench top, pipettes, and racks using Nucleo-clean, 70% ethanol, and RNAzap wipes.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Tube
steps.instruction: Prepare a 15ml tube by adding 750ul Lysis Buffer and 0.5ml of RNA Powersoil beads (1/2 of a tube).

steps.title: Recover Cells from RNAlater
steps.instruction: Recover cells from the RNAlater solution used for filter preservation.

substeps.instruction: Pipette RNAlater into a new 2ml tube.
Spin down cells at 12,000xg for 5min.
Pour off RNAlater and place the tube on ice.
Repeat rounds if necessary depending on the amount of RNAlater.
If only extracting half of the filter, only remove half of the RNAlater volume.

steps.title: Process Filter for Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract the filter material and transfer it to the lysis tube.

substeps.instruction: Remove the filter from the tube and place it on a sterile/autoclaved piece of foil.

For 47mm flat filters: Use an ethanol-flamed razor blade and forceps to cut the filter in half (if only extracting half), then cut the remaining half into small pieces and place them in the 15ml tube.
For Sterivex filters: Use ethanol-flamed pliers to crack the cartridge, remove the filter with a razor blade, and cut it into 6-8 pieces; place pieces in the 15ml tube.
For Sterivex filters: Pour RNAlater from the cartridge into a 2ml tube and spin down as described in the cell recovery step.

steps.title: Combine Samples and Lyse
steps.instruction: Combine the recovered cells and filter pieces for homogenization.

substeps.instruction: Add 250ul Lysis buffer to the 2ml tube containing spun-down cells, resuspend by vortexing, and add this to the 15ml tube.
Using an adaptor, vortex the 15ml tube for 7-10min at medium-high speed.

steps.title: Homogenize and Clarify
steps.instruction: Treat the homogenate and remove debris.

substeps.instruction: Add 100ul Homogenate additive and place on ice for 10min.
Centrifuge the tube at 4000xg for 2min at 4ºC.
Remove the lysate and place it in a 2ml tube; repeat centrifugation if necessary to remove all lysate.

steps.title: Perform Phenol-Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Purify the RNA using acid:phenol chloroform in a fume hood while wearing double gloves.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 part acid:phenol chloroform to the tube (equal to the volume of lysate removed).
Centrifuge at 10,000xg for 5min.
Carefully remove the top aqueous layer and place it in a fresh 2ml tube, ensuring the bottom layer is not touched.

steps.title: Prepare for Column Purification
steps.instruction: Prepare the aqueous phase for filter cartridge loading.

substeps.instruction: Heat the elution solution (using a small aliquot in a 1.5mL tube) to 95ºC in a heat block.
Add 1.25x 100% ethanol and mix well.

steps.title: Purify RNA via Filter Cartridge
steps.instruction: Bind and wash the RNA using a filter cartridge.

substeps.instruction: Add the ethanol-mixed solution to the filter cartridge in a collection tube.
Centrifuge at 10,000xg for 15sec and discard the flow through (repeat spins if volume exceeds ~700ul).
Add 700ul Wash Solution 1, spin at 10,000xg for 15sec, and discard flow through.
Add 500ul Wash Solution 2/3, spin at 10,000xg for 15sec, and discard flow through.
Repeat the Wash Solution 2/3 step.
Place the cartridge back into the tube and centrifuge for 1.5 min at 10,000xg to remove residual fluid.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA from the cartridge.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the filter cartridge into a fresh collection tube.
Apply 50 µl pre-heated (95 ºC) Elution solution to the center of the filter and spin for 30 sec at 10,000 X g.
Repeat the elution with another 50 µl pre-heated (95ºC) Elution Solution.

steps.title: Store RNA
steps.instruction: Store the extracted RNA based on the required duration.

substeps.instruction: Freeze at -80ºC for long term storage.
Store at -20ºC for short term (24-48hrs).
Set heat block to 37ºC.
Transfer 100ul of sample from the mirVana collection tube to a 1.5 ml centrifuge tube.
Add 10ul 10x Buffer to the 100ul RNA.
Add 1ul Turbo DNAse and incubate at 37ºC for 20min.
Add another 1ul of Turbo DNase and incubate for an additional 20min.
Add 10ul Inactivation Reagent and vortex on and off for 5 min.
Spin tubes at 10,000xg for 1.5min.
Pipet the RNA into a new 0.5ml tube, ensuring the inactivation reagent is not touched.
